events.text: Big banks report heavy losses on US sub-prime mortgages.
Bear Stearns is rescued in a deal with JPMorgan.
G20 leaders agree a USD 1.1 trillion package to support the world economy.
COVID-19 spreads beyond China and markets start to fall.
Markets rebound after large central-bank and government support.
The first successful vaccine trial results lift markets.
The US Federal Reserve starts raising interest rates.
The Fed raises rates by 0.75 points, its largest rise since 1994.
Stocks and bonds both end the year sharply down.
